title: A Inventory for the Blue Hour
author: Jonah Whitlock
blurb: Theo Sandoval, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
